easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
